newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 45.147 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 45.147 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Monday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.44 percent and 16.24 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 65.994 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 45.147 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 30,693.1 million levs 35,301.1 million levs
Bids approved 17,845.6 million levs 27,301.1 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.44 pct 16.24 pct
